ctx.x: No, that’s Alphonse Lambert. Wellman Braud is another uncle. He might be the great great uncle. Wellman Braud, he played bass with Duke Ellington.
Hot and Bothered. I don’t know if he’s on that one. That one brought the bass to the forefront too.
